    pos = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(n):
        pos[p[i]] = i
    
    # Check if a valid permutation q exists
    visited = [False] * n
    for i in range(n):
        if visited[i]:
            continue

        x = i
        while not visited[x]:
            visited[x] = True
            x = pos[p[x]]
            cycle_length += 1
        
        # If the cycle length is odd, no valid q exists
        if cycle_length % 2 != 0:
            return [-1]
    
    # Construct the permutation q
    q = [0] * n
    visited = [False] * n
    for i in range(n):
        if visited[i]:
            continue

        # Pair up elements in the cycle
        for j in range(0, len(cycle), 2):
            q[cycle[j]] = cycle[j + 1] + 1
            q[cycle[j + 1]] = cycle[j] + 1
    
    return q
